title: A registry listing
description: `plugins/<id>/listing.json`: where the plugin lives and exactly which commit was reviewed. What is listed is what was reviewed; a plugin cannot change what a family sees by pushing to its own repository.

commit.description: The full 40-character commit hash the listing was reviewed at. A tag or a branch is not accepted: those move.

listedAt.description: The date the listing (or its latest re-pin) was approved, YYYY-MM-DD.

verified.description: Made and maintained by Five More Minutes. Only accepted for repositories owned by an organisation in verified-owners.json.
